name: Observation Point via the East Mesa Trail
why: An easy walk through ponderosa pines on the mesa to the edge where all of Zion Canyon, Angels Landing included, lies 650 m below.
book: No permit. The East Mesa trailhead is outside the canyon, reached by car from the East Entrance via North Fork Road (dirt, rough after rain; shuttles from private outfitters). The old route from Weeping Rock is closed by a rockfall.
dangers: Unfenced cliff edge at the point.
The dirt road is slick after rain.

points.name: East Mesa trailhead
points.note: A small parking area in the pines on the mesa.

points.name: Observation Point
points.note: A sandstone point at 1,980 m looking straight down Zion Canyon.
